fusions.name: Clean Snip
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Thrusts at it from up to 6 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Strand to Strand
fusions.desc: Throws a threaded point that deals 8 damage, then runs along the thread to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Woven Close
fusions.desc: Weaves a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 5%.

fusions.name: Spun and Sewn
fusions.desc: Every hit you land spins a stack on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
